authenticated_paper.title: SAGE: Subgoal-Conditioned Action Generation for Latent World Model Planning
authenticated_paper.profile_match: Official abstract describes duration-conditioned intermediate latent subgoals, action proposals and frozen-world-model evaluation/refinement; LIBERO abstract explicitly names vanilla LeWM.
authenticated_paper.method_quote: At each planning stage, a goal-conditioned generator predicts the next intermediate latent subgoal for a specified duration, which is then used to condition the generation of candidate action sequences.
authenticated_paper.frozen_model_quote: Then the frozen world model evaluates these proposals against the same subgoal and guides their refinement before execution.
